holes_in_opposing_case: mean-reverter's USD-lower/CAD-higher fade of leftover SR3H7 after a delivered 25bp hike ignores still-hot US gauges (labor 75, inflation 72) and a still-rising SR3 path (Dec 4.32, Mar 4.58, Sep 4.755). FACT: the hike is already in SOFR 3.85 and August CPI kept a tightening bias. Their spot alternative (short USDCAD) fights 140bp 2Y carry while USDCAD 3m is still -1.25%. The analog set is mixed (2022 continuation versus 2023-02 reversal), so a 1y US 2Y extreme is not a one-way mean-reversion mandate. UNKNOWN: the next US print; that is a risk, not proof the Fed is one-and-done.

value-guy's USD-lower/CAD-higher compression of CA-US 2Y -140bp (3.8th 1y / 4.3rd 5y) treats a labor-and-policy gap as a peer dislocation. FACT: CA labor 38 versus US 75, Canada core near 2% versus US inflation 72, overnight CORRA 2.29 versus SOFR 3.85. Paying 2027 CORRA requires Canada to catch a still-hiking Fed that Canadian labor/core have not validated. Their 2025-01-30 analog (spread often stops widening once this cheap) is why the residual is incomplete USDCAD translation, not more CAD-rate catch-up. Short USDCAD as their spot candidate is carry-opposed.

cross-merchant short AUDCAD claims USD contaminates AU-versus-CA, but the CAD-up leg is the hole. FACT: CA labor 38, CAD leveraged funds still net short 39022 after covering, Saudi STS reduced the oil-supply tail, AUDCAD 0.9976 at 99.96th 5y, and short AUDCAD fights 164.9bp 2Y / 206bp overnight carry. If AU housing bites, AUDUSD can fall without CAD rising versus a delivered Fed hike. The cross adds RBA/housing second-order risk when CAD weakness is already expressible in USDCAD with 140bp carry support.

perma-bull pay-CORRA / CAD-higher contradicts the Canada labor/core facts they acknowledge: employment -42k, wages +2.0% y/y, trim/median 1.9/2.0, 1m CORRA only +29bp by Dec. Energy pass-through is BoC minutes language, not a delivered hiking cycle. Paying CRAH27 3.13 buys 84bp of already-priced 2027 catch-up. Their rejected short-USDCAD is the USD-spot expression of a still-cheap CAD; paying CAD rates is the crowded energy-hawk overlay.

carry-is-king, positioning-cynic, and rate-dove concede USD-up/CAD-down then receive 2027 CORRA. That duplicates a 4th-percentile CA-US 2Y / ~140bp 2027 H1 SOFR-CORRA gap already in rates. FACT: USDCAD 3m still -1.25%, 1y percentile only 74.0. CAD covering is a flow headwind, not evidence that spot finished the translation. Rate-dove's claim that oil/covering can hold CAD up even if CRA cheapens is an admission that rates P&L can print while the FX residual — the incomplete USD expression — remains.

rate-hawk and trend-follower pay SOFR for US-terminal persistence while tagging USD-up/CAD-down, then call USDCAD mixed. The mix is two same-direction legs: USD policy premium and CAD labor weakness. Paying SR3H7 4.58 / SR3U7 4.755 can be right on US rates and still miss the 156-174bp overnight/Dec SOFR-CORRA gap that EURUSD/GBPUSD already translated (-1.89%/-2.07% 1m) while USDCAD's 3m path remains negative.

catalyst-junkie and perma-bear receive AONIA for AU housing, tag USD-up/AUD-down, then refuse short AUDUSD because copper/energy and CFTC AUD longs can keep AUD bid. That is why the defensible USD pair is USDCAD, not an AU housing receive that can be right in AONIA while AUDUSD holds. AU inflation gauge 82 still argues against treating stamp-duty prints as a dated RBA hold.

vol-convexity NZD-higher via 3M AUDNZD puts: FACT: NZDUSD is already 12.9th 1y / 8.6th 5y, -3.90% 1m; NZ labor 32; NZ rates and NZDUSD carry are unavailable; NZ GDP beat and India FTA did not reverse NZD. Buying NZD convexity after that collapse is catching a delivered USD-high-beta move. Premium/IV/strike are packet-null and their paper book is HOLD, so they did not even put on the NZD-up risk they tagged. Dollar-king NZD-lower is consistent with that USD-spot collapse; it is not the primary trade because NZ policy path and carry cannot be marked.
attack: The only seats that actually reverse USD and CAD (mean-reverter, value-guy) need the Fed hike to be a finished event and Canada cheapness to be a fade. Packet facts still show US labor/inflation hot, SR3 still hiking, and Canada labor/core soft. Fading USDCAD therefore fights 140bp 2Y carry against an incomplete 3m reversal.

CAD-higher via cross (cross-merchant) or via paying CORRA (perma-bull, value-guy) adds the wrong second-order risk. Short AUDCAD loads RBA/housing and 165bp of opposing carry; paying 2027 CORRA buys an already-priced 84-130bp catch-up that labor 38 and core near 2% have not validated. The weak CAD leg is cleaner against USD.

Rates seats that share USD-up/CAD-down then park it in CORRA/AONIA/SOFR are arguing expression, not direction. CA-US 2Y is already extreme; USDCAD 3m is still negative. Receiving more Canada cheapness or paying more US terminal duplicates priced policy paths and leaves the untranslated USD-spot residual on the table. Covering, oil, and AUD housing are reasons their rates books can be right while USD/CAD still has work to do — which is an argument for the USD pair, not against it.
NZD-higher is a post-collapse options story with no NZ policy path, no NZD carry screen, and a HOLD paper book. It does not displace long USDCAD as the actionable USD-spot expression.
defense: FACT: Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00%; SOFR 3.85; SR3 still prices 4.32/4.58/4.755; CORRA 2.29 with only 2.58 by Dec and 3.13 by Mar-27; CA-US 2Y -140bp at 3.8th 1y; US labor/inflation 75/72 versus CA 38/55; Canada core near 2%; USDCAD 1.40105 is +1.74% 1m but still -1.25% 3m, 1y percentile 74.0. Carry screen supports long USD versus CAD by 140bp. CFTC CAD leveraged funds remain net short 39022 after covering. Saudi STS reduced the extreme oil-supply tail. EURUSD/GBPUSD have already sold 1.9-2.1% 1m.

INFERENCE: rates have already marked Canada unusually cheap versus the US. Spot has not finished translating that into USDCAD. That path discrepancy is the trade. A cross such as AUDCAD adds AU housing/RBA risk and fights 165bp of carry. Receiving 2027 CORRA duplicates the 4th-percentile rates gap. Paying SOFR owns only the US terminal and misses the CAD labor/policy gap. Short USDCAD as a fade fights carry and a still-negative 3m path.

UNKNOWN: whether energy pass-through forces a faster BoC catch-up; whether residual CAD shorts complete covering without further USD upside; whether the 2023-02 US 2Y analog repeats. Those are already principal risks, not a reason to reverse USD-up/CAD-down.

Concede the argument if the US path is recast as one-and-done while CORRA/CA 2Y reprice toward SR3/US 2Y enough to close the 156-174bp near-term gap, or if Canada labor/core reheat and restore a CAD-tightening bid, or if a renewed energy shock reasserts CAD via the BoC pass-through channel. Covering noise or a rates-only P&L print without that policy-gap close is not concession. Trade and book stay unchanged: long USDCAD, sidecar was empty, OPEN $55m.

expression_comparison.rates_candidate: Pay CORRA / receive SOFR or fade the already-extreme CA-US 2Y at -140bp (1y percentile 3.77, 5y 4.31). That rates gap is already at a multi-year cheap-Canada extreme, so more curve risk mainly duplicates a priced policy differential rather than capturing the still-incomplete FX adjustment.
expression_comparison.rationale: Dedicated USD-spot seat. The discrepancy is that USDCAD only partly reversed a still-negative 3m path after the Fed hike, while CA-US 2Y, SOFR-CORRA, and US-versus-CA labor/inflation already show a wide USD-policy advantage. A cross such as AUDCAD (1y/5y ~99.8th) adds unnecessary RBA/housing second-order risk when the weak CAD leg can be expressed directly against USD with carry support.

context_build.causal_mechanism: A delivered Fed hike plus a still-rising SOFR/SR3 path widens the USD funding and growth premium versus a BoC that remains 156bp cheaper overnight, with weak Canadian labor and contained core inflation limiting how fast CORRA can catch SR3. That policy-and-labor gap should keep USD bid versus CAD in spot.
context_build.path_to_current_price: ECB-cross USDCAD as of 2026-09-18 is 1.40105. The pair is still down 1.25% over 3m, then reversed +1.74% over 1m and +1.10% over 5d as August US CPI, >90% hike pricing into the Sep-16 FOMC, the 25bp hike, and the SOFR jump to 3.85 arrived. US 2Y rose 57bp over 1m and 9bp on 18-Sep to 4.76; CA 2Y fell 8bp on 17-Sep to 3.27, taking CA-US 2Y to -140bp. USDCAD therefore turned after a 3m CAD-firm stretch, but the 1y percentile is only 74.0 (5y 87.0), not a completed one-way squeeze.
context_build.known_vs_new_information: Known before the cutoff: US inflation/labor heat, Canada 3% headline / ~2% core, BoC energy-pass-through minutes, and a large US-CA yield gap. Newly operative now: the hike was delivered (SOFR 3.62 on 16-Sep to 3.85 on 17-Sep), SR3 still prices additional tightening (Dec 4.32, Mar 4.58, 12m 4.755), and the 5d CA-US 2Y move of -15bp (z -2.17) arrived alongside only a 1.10% USDCAD rise. The Saudi Oman STS workaround also modestly reduced the extreme oil-supply tail that had been a CAD support.
context_build.market_implied_assumption: Current pricing assumes the Fed hike is largely a USD event already absorbed in G10 (EURUSD -1.89% 1m, GBPUSD -2.07% 1m) and that CAD can remain relatively firm because BoC minutes keep an energy-inflation option open and CORRA is allowed to grind toward 2.58 by Dec and ~3.65 by 2028 without a USD/CAD catch-up.
context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: The assumption that USDCAD has already done enough of the Fed-versus-BoC work. Rates have priced a near-extreme Canada cheapness; spot has not finished the 3m reversal, and Canada’s labor gauge (38) versus US labor (75) does not support CAD holding a high real-rate/commodity premium against a still-hiking Fed.

The Jan-2025 CA-US analog shows the rate spread may already be extreme enough to stop widening, which is why the residual is in spot, not in buying more Canada cheapness on the curve. Energy is also two-sided now (Saudi STS workaround versus weaker shock absorbers), unlike a clean 2022 oil-shock CAD bid. Packet FX is a 2026-09-18 ECB cross, two days before cutoff.

revised_trade.thesis: FACT: Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00%; SOFR 3.85; US 2Y 4.76; SR3 still prices 4.32/4.58 at 3m/6m. FACT: CORRA 2.29; CA 2Y 3.27; CA-US 2Y -140bp; Canada labor gauge 38 versus US 75; Canada core near 2%. FACT: USDCAD 1.40105 is +1.74% 1m but still -1.25% 3m. INFERENCE: the USD-versus-CAD policy and labor gap is cleaner in spot than in rates because the sovereign/OIS differential is already extreme, while EURUSD/GBPUSD have already sold 1.9-2.1% 1m and AUDUSD still has AONIA/AU 2Y carry against a short. UNKNOWN: whether energy pass-through forces a faster BoC catch-up, and whether CAD short-covering completes without further USD upside.
revised_trade.mispricing: Rates have already marked Canada unusually cheap versus the US (CA-US 2Y 3.8th 1y percentile). USDCAD has not finished translating that into spot: 3m still negative, 1y only 74th percentile, and the 5d rates move (CA-US 2Y z -2.17) exceeded the still-moderate 1.10% FX move. That is a path discrepancy, not a claim that a regression residual is fair value (USDCAD~CA-US_2Y r^2 is 0.022).
why_now: The Sep-16 hike is now in the SOFR print and in SR3, so the USD overnight benchmark has jumped while CORRA has not.
The 5d CA-US 2Y widening is the largest short-horizon rates impulse in the packet and arrived with USDCAD still below a completed 3m recovery.
Saudi STS workaround reduced the extreme oil-supply tail that had been a CAD offset, while BoC minutes still treat energy as a risk rather than a delivered tightening cycle.
Sidecar is flat; funding vig on the full $100m at 3.85% SOFR makes a defined USD-spot book preferable to staying idle.

revised_trade.invalidation: Thesis is invalid if the US path is fully recast as one-and-done while CORRA/CA 2Y reprice toward SR3/US 2Y enough to close the policy gap, or if Canada labor/core reheat and restore a CAD-tightening bid, or if a renewed energy shock reasserts CAD via the BoC pass-through channel. No invented numeric stop.
catalysts: Next US inflation/labor prints that keep the SR3 hike path intact after the delivered 25bp.
BoC communication or Canadian labor/CPI that fails to close the 156bp overnight gap.
Oil remaining contained after the Saudi Oman workaround, limiting CAD’s energy offset.
Continued CAD leveraged-fund residual shorts after incomplete covering.

US 2Y analog risk: the 2023-02-16 episode reversed a similar-sized 1m yield rise.
CAD short-covering already started; a squeeze can fade USDCAD without changing the rates gap.
Packet FX is two days old; CA official curve and CME positioning are missing.
A cross-led AUDCAD unwind could move CAD without a clean USD impulse.

paper_actions.rationale: Empty sidecar. Deploy $55m of the $100m gross cap in the single cleanest USD spot: long USDCAD. Size is below cap to leave room if energy/CAD covering volatility rises, but large enough versus 3.85% SOFR vig if spot continues the incomplete 3m reversal. Trusted code must transact at the packet mid; no authored mark.
paper_actions.thesis: USD policy/labor premium versus a cheap BoC is already extreme in CA-US 2Y and SOFR-CORRA; express it in USDCAD spot, not a cross and not more curve.
